# rspack-plugin-svg-sprite

> SVG sprite loader and plugin for Rspack, Rsbuild and webpack 5. A drop-in replacement for svg-sprite-loader. Each SVG import gives { id, viewBox, url } for use with <use>.

Install: npm i -D rspack-plugin-svg-sprite

Minimal config (extract mode):

    const { SvgSpritePlugin } = require('rspack-plugin-svg-sprite');
    module.exports = {
      module: { rules: [{
        test: /\.svg$/,
        type: 'javascript/auto',
        loader: 'rspack-plugin-svg-sprite/loader',
        options: { extract: true, esModule: false },
      }] },
      plugins: [new SvgSpritePlugin()],
    };
